experiment: ECL Alpaca IEX OHLCV sequence binary research v1

target_definition.NEUTRAL: otherwise; excluded from binary fitting and directional metrics

source_policy: Only the approved pre-test raw ECL IEX 5-minute train-validation cache, existing train.csv and validation.csv, and saved v3 OOF/validation predictions for baseline alignment may be read. No canonical file spanning the test dates is used.

sequence.price_transform: For each sequence, each OHLC value is 100 * (price / current sequence-end close - 1).
sequence.volume_transform: log1p(volume); channel scaling is StandardScaler fit on training sequence windows only within each fold/model fit.
sequence.continuity: Every adjacent source timestamp must differ by exactly five minutes and share the same America/New_York session date. No session crossing, missing-bar filling, interpolation or fabricated observations.
sequence.sample_time: Sequence ends at the labeled decision candle; no source candle after that candle is included.

models.sequence_model: Small regularized 1D CNN: causal Conv1D(8, kernel=3), global average pooling, Dense(8, relu, L2=0.01), Dropout(0.20), sigmoid output; Adam 0.001; binary cross entropy; 20 fixed epochs; batch 32; shuffle false.
models.baselines: Saved v3 Random Forest and XGBoost OOF/validation predictions are aligned to the identical eligible timestamps for each sequence length. No baseline rules or indicators are used.
models.binary_decision: UP if predicted P(UP) >= 0.5, else DOWN; no threshold search or abstention.

walk_forward.folds: Reuse the four established expanding chronological train-date folds in reports/alpaca_binary_research_v3/walk_forward_folds.csv.
walk_forward.purge: For each fold, remove training samples with future_datetime at or after the first held-out decision timestamp.
walk_forward.preprocessing: Fit channel scaler separately on each fold's training sequences only.

validation: All four predeclared sequence lengths are evaluated once on the existing validation period for diagnostic comparison; this period has prior research exposure and is not a pristine holdout. Validation results are not used for selection or tuning.
selection: No promotion. Compare OOF fold consistency and matched-timestamp baseline results; report validation as limited confirmation only.
